hardware_behavior_confirmed: With DP video active (DDC 0x60 = 8), the OSD and BLE GET both still indicated Type-C. Explicit BLE ED 01 02 aligned the menu to DP, confirmed by two independent input queries and the physical OSD.
BLE input was tested with active video on Type-C, DP and HDMI 2; the monitor OSD followed the selected input.
The USB hub moved to Type-B for DP and Type-C for Type-C in the tested two-computer setup.
Writing headphone volume 0 through vendor DDC C8 updated the OSD to 0 and muted the 3.5 mm output.
palette_reference: Official Android app view binding confirms 1=red 2=yellow 3=green 4=cyan 5=blue 6=purple 7=multicolour

lighting_power.on_operation: Reapply current effect with EE 04 xx, then independently read DE 01 00; EE 01 02 is not an implemented stock setter

ddc_read_compatibility: Persistent native IOAV session; strict validation; bounded independent retries; standard brightness only; latest absolute writes preempt background reads; preserve last confirmed cache on failure
channel_selection_reads: first use, missing values, reconnect, and a throttled check of the visible input on panel entry
input_menu_sync: An explicit DDC port selection may also write the corresponding BLE menu input on an already authorized and configured device. Panel entry and refresh only query state.

input_mapping_evidence.DDC: Model-specific VCP 0x60 values from the reference firmware.
input_mapping_evidence.BLE: The monitor reports an input ID. Labels correspond to physical ports on the standard model.
input_mapping_evidence.HDMI_DDC_verification: Both HDMI mappings were checked offline; physical video switching via DDC has not been confirmed.
